verdict.rationale: Square documents the main platform building blocks. The OAuth API connects an app to each seller's own Square account, and multi-tenant apps serving multiple sellers are directed to use OAuth tokens. A "Collect Application Fees" capability lets the platform take a cut of each seller's payment, and a Payouts API exists. The evidence is mostly page titles, though, and shows only a platform-fee model rather than arbitrary multi-party splits. missing for 10: in-platform seller onboarding/KYC (sellers connect existing Square accounts via OAuth), multi-party payment splitting beyond an application fee, evidence that the Payouts API lets a platform direct payouts per seller rather than just reporting them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
